name: duotronic/duo-wp-dev
description: Developer-only toolchain for the Duo WordPress drop-in. Never shipped: cli/src/Onboarding/Adopt.php tars exactly 'agent manifests recovery', so nothing at the repo root can reach a managed site.

scripts.lint: dirs=''; for d in agent cli recovery scripts tools tests; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then dirs="$dirs $d"; fi; done; { find $dirs -type f -name '*.php' -print0; if [ -d cli ]; then find cli -maxdepth 1 -type f -name duo -print0; fi; } | xargs -0 -P 8 -n 1 php -l > /dev/null && echo 'lint: ok'
scripts.cs: kept=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$kept"' EXIT; { git diff -z --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR origin/main... -- '*.php' 2>/dev/null; git diff -z --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -- '*.php'; git diff -z --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -- '*.php'; git ls-files -z --others --exclude-standard -- '*.php'; } | sort -zu | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do case "$f" in agent/*|cli/*|recovery/*|scripts/*|tools/*|tests/*) [ -f "$f" ] && printf '%s\0' "$f" ;; esac; done > "$kept"; if [ -s "$kept" ]; then xargs -0 php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --config=.php-cs-fixer.dist.php -- < "$kept"; else echo 'cs: no changed php files'; fi
scripts.cs:fix: kept=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$kept"' EXIT; { git diff -z --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR origin/main... -- '*.php' 2>/dev/null; git diff -z --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -- '*.php'; git diff -z --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -- '*.php'; git ls-files -z --others --exclude-standard -- '*.php'; } | sort -zu | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do case "$f" in agent/*|cli/*|recovery/*|scripts/*|tools/*|tests/*) [ -f "$f" ] && printf '%s\0' "$f" ;; esac; done > "$kept"; if [ -s "$kept" ]; then xargs -0 php-cs-fixer fix --diff --config=.php-cs-fixer.dist.php -- < "$kept"; else echo 'cs: no changed php files'; fi

scripts-descriptions.check: lint + phpstan + php-cs-fixer (changed files) + phpunit — the whole dev gate.
scripts-descriptions.lint: php -l over every first-party PHP file, 8-way parallel.
scripts-descriptions.stan: phpstan analyse over the whole tree at the committed baseline (see phpstan-baseline.neon and the ceiling ratchet test).
scripts-descriptions.cs: php-cs-fixer --dry-run over changed PHP files only (never the whole tree: agent/, cli/, recovery/, scripts/ are certification-closure members — see .php-cs-fixer.dist.php's own header).
scripts-descriptions.cs:fix: Same changed-files selection as 'cs', but rewrites those files in place instead of reporting a diff.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: phpunit over tests/ (fast, no docker, no WordPress bootstrap).
